integrity: All theorem parameters, exact boundary counts, and full successor window inequalities are proved in the accompanying result; finite verification only cross-checks samples. Novelty is qualified by sources inspected, with no independent validation claimed.
scientific_limitations: Restricted to odd \(a=2h+1\ge3\), coprime \(1\le d\le h\), and \(h+1\le p\le a+d\); no formula is asserted outside this domain.
The generalized Frobenius maximum is computed, but no complete \(p\)-Apéry set, \(p\)-genus or arbitrary-threshold formula is determined.
Unindexed equivalent work may exist; independent audit has not been performed.
title: A second linear phase for generalized Frobenius numbers of arithmetic triples
